summary: Four studies directly apply federated learning (decentralised training without pooled records) to customer churn/attrition prediction, and one applies a multilevel probabilistic model to the same task. [V0201] (Chen et al., 2019) evaluates on ChurnBench, reporting accuracy 0.78. [V0203] (El-Sayed et al., 2021) evaluates on Atlas-ICU, reporting AUROC 0.92 — the strongest result among the federated churn studies. [V0202] (Duarte et al., 2020) evaluates on MetroFlow, reporting MAE 0.85. [V0204] (Fischer et al., 2022) evaluates on AgriSat-4, reporting F1 0.64 — the weakest federated churn result. [V0211] (Gupta et al., 2023) applies multilevel probabilistic models with partial pooling to customer attrition on Atlas-ICU, achieving accuracy 0.79; it is included as the fifth-ranked document because it directly addresses the churn task, though it does not use federated learning. Documents mentioning federated churn only as prior work (V0052, V0045, V0101) are excluded as non-applications.

claims.value: Decentralised Training Without Pooled Records (federated learning)
